hero.kicker: Clinic operating system · Cloud software for practices
hero.title: The operating system for growing your business
hero.lead: AI messaging, scheduling, CRM, and books in one window. Take routine off the team and grow revenue.
hero.shotAlt: Product interface: navigation, conversations, CRM, and team context

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.lead: Built for companies where dense booking, money control, and returning clients matter.

medical.title: Healthcare and beauty
medical.body: Dental practices, clinics, salon networks. Complex schedules and materials tracking.

practice.title: Private practice and consulting
practice.body: Psychologists, lawyers, tutors. Deposits and booking without a front desk.

sport.title: Sport and wellness
sport.body: Fitness studios, yoga, massage. Memberships and group classes.

crm.title: Sales (CRM)
crm.body: A funnel from first contact to payment.

finance.title: Books and finance
finance.body: Cash registers, deposits, payroll, and inventory.

tasks.title: Tasks and assignments
tasks.body: Deadlines and a single work surface.

analytics.title: Analytics and reports
analytics.body: An owner dashboard: from staff load to marketing return, in real time, without Excel exports.

retention.title: Keep every inquiry
retention.body: One inbox for channels. AI answers quickly and offers open slots while the administrator is with a patient.

routine.title: Less routine
routine.body: Tasks, schedule, and payroll are automated. Work that used to take several people can run in one contour.

revenue.title: Revenue from every client
revenue.body: Visit reminders, membership write-offs, and bringing inactive clients back with targeted campaigns.

security.title: Data security
security.body: Organization data is isolated. AI uses context through a de-identification layer aligned with personal-data rules.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.lead: Choose a fit for the scale of your business.

bullets.0: Up to 3 locations, up to 20 staff
bullets.1: AI assistant in chats: drafts and routing
bullets.2: Books and finance: cash, deposits, payments

bullets.1: Team chat and an AI-assisted knowledge base
bullets.2: Tasks: deadlines, owners, and AI-backed flows

bullets.0: No hard cap on locations or scenarios
bullets.1: Your brand in the patient app
